race.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 50' Handicap
race.verdict: Lightly-raced MURAT should be well suited by all-weather and he's fancied to make it 2 wins from 5 starts on the Flat. The main danger could be Zoffman , who is lurking on a dangerous mark, while Star Harbour looks interesting tackling 2m for the first time. MURAT (IRE) ZOFFMAN (IRE) STAR HARBOUR (IRE)
